\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\newcommand{\point}[2]{\pgfextractx{\dimen0}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}\pgfextracty{\dimen2}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}\typeout{POINT #1.#2: \the\dimen0,\the\dimen2}}
\newcommand{\report}{\point{current axis}{south west}\point{current axis}{north east}\point{current bounding box}{south west}\point{current bounding box}{north east}}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[compat=1.18,xmin=0,xmax=5,ymin=0,ymax=5,
  xticklabel style={name=xt},yticklabel style={name=yt}]
  \addplot[mark=none] coordinates {(0,2) (5,2)};
\end{axis}
\typeout{CASE default}\report
\point{xt}{center}\point{xt}{text}\point{yt}{center}\point{yt}{text}
\end{tikzpicture}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[compat=1.18,axis lines=middle,scale only axis,width=6cm,height=4cm,
  xmin=-1,xmax=1,ymin=-1,ymax=1,enlargelimits=false,
  xtick={-1,0,1},ytick={-1,0,1},xlabel={office AV},ylabel={gyp},
  label style={font=\small,text=red,inner sep=2pt},
  x label style={name=xl,at={(axis description cs:0.25,-0.1)},anchor=north,xshift=3pt,yshift=-2pt},
  ylabel style={name=yl,at={(-0.1,0.5)},anchor=south,rotate=90,font=\large,text=blue}]
\end{axis}
\typeout{CASE explicit}\report
\point{xl}{center}\point{xl}{text}\point{xl}{north}
\point{yl}{center}\point{yl}{text}\point{yl}{south}
\end{tikzpicture}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[scale only axis,width=6cm,height=4cm,
  xmin=-1,xmax=1,ymin=-1,ymax=1,enlargelimits=false,
  xtick={-1,0,1},ytick={-1,0,1},xlabel={office AV},ylabel={gyp},
  xlabel style={name=xl,at={(axis description cs:0.25,0)},anchor=north},
  ylabel style={name=yl,at={(-0.1,0.75)},anchor=south}]
\end{axis}
\typeout{CASE absolute}\report
\point{xl}{center}\point{xl}{text}\point{xl}{north}
\point{yl}{center}\point{yl}{text}\point{yl}{south}
\end{tikzpicture}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[compat=1.18,scale only axis,width=6cm,height=4cm,
  xmin=-1,xmax=1,ymin=-1,ymax=1,enlargelimits=false,
  xtick={-1,0,1},ytick={-1,0,1},xlabel={office AV},ylabel={gyp},
  x label style={name=xl,at={(axis description cs:0.25,-0.1)},anchor=north,
    xshift=3pt,rotate=30,yshift=4pt,rotate=-30,xshift=2pt},
  ylabel style={name=yl,at={(-0.1,0.5)},anchor=south,xshift=6pt,yshift=2pt}]
\end{axis}
\typeout{CASE transform}\report
\point{xl}{center}\point{xl}{text}\point{xl}{north}
\point{yl}{center}\point{yl}{text}\point{yl}{south}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
